version: plan v5 round 1 -- safe ES (round-5 configuration of plan v4 + per-generation safety check with revert)
written_before: any plan-v5 search, selection or blind test; no learned controller has been run on the plan-v5 nod/dash blind set
decided_by: the user (2026-10-18 JST): a new plan after plan v4 round 6, seed 1 first on CloudPC-3, compared with plan-v4 rounds 5 and 6 seed 1
relation_to_plan_v4: plan v4 ends with round 6 (pre-registered as final); its verdict is reported unchanged. Plan v5 is a separate, pre-registered study of one method change; the paper reports both plans and all rounds.

method.base: plan v4 round 5 exactly (RefractoryLearned, nod:dash 2:1 objective + tilt penalty from 60 deg x0.3, 8 nod + 4 dash cases per ES candidate, OpenAI-ES pop 32, sigma .03, Adam .02)
method.safety_check: after every ES generation the new centre flies 64 nod + 64 dash training cases (offset 150_000, disjoint from ES batches, selection cases and blind sets); any crash or tilt >= 70 deg -> the update is reverted (theta and Adam moments restored), the generation counter advances and the next generation draws new perturbations
method.implementation: descend_safe.py (one generation per descend.finetune resume; revert path tested with a forced failure on claude-ea)

selection: as plan v4 round 5: 64 nod + 64 dash validation cases (offset 60_000 + 10_000), zero crashes and tilt < 70 deg, lowest 2:1 penalised composite; on claude-ea

seeds.order: seed 1 first on CloudPC-3 (30 workers); seeds 2 and 3 afterwards on any machine

test_sets.nod_dash: fresh blind set, maneuver_v2 base 2_096_800_000 (never used)
test_sets.normaliser_rule: nod/dash opponent per-case median on the fresh blind set (learned side: mean incl. crashes); hover/upset opponent mean (unchanged sets, claude-ea rows)
test_sets.note: the classical schedule crashes on 2 of 16 nod blind cases of this set; the per-case median normaliser (0.943) is unaffected, the learned side is scored by its mean incl. crashes

hypotheses.H1: blind composite (25/25/25/25) <= 0.95 (strict) AND T1 <= 1.05, in >= 2 of 3 seeds
hypotheses.H5: 0 crashes in the 32 nod+dash blind episodes, in >= 2 of 3 seeds
hypotheses.S1_mechanism: on the 128 selection cases, the fraction of saved centres with zero crashes is higher than for plan-v4 round 5 (same configuration without the safety check), seed by seed; reported with round 6 as a second reference
hypotheses.secondary: number of reverted generations, selected generation, paired wins, crash types

comparisons: seed-1 centres of plan-v4 rounds 5 and 6 on the identical 128 selection cases (same validation generator and offset)
